title: Wild Garlic Curry with Earthy Hearty Vegetables
description: A flavorful and nutritious curry made with wild garlic, hearty vegetables, and a touch of malaysian spices.

ingredients.name: Earthy Hearty Vegetables (Carrots, Potatoes, Sweet Potatoes)

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped wild garlic and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the Malaysian curry paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped hearty vegetables and stir to combine.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
